s1_netrev_p2: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM returns)
s1_aov: SELECT SUM(line_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items
s1_aov_p2: SELECT SUM(line_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items
s1_aov_p3: SELECT SUM(line_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items
s1_margin: SELECT SUM((oi.unit_price - p.unit_cost) * oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key
s1_gross_rev: SELECT SUM(p.list_price * oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key
s1_top_customer: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(oi.line_total) as total_spent FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_key = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1
s2_shipping_region: SELECT ship_region, SUM(shipping_fee) FROM orders GROUP BY ship_region
s2_rev_and_ship: SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(oi.line_total) as net_revenue, SUM(o.shipping_fee) as total_shipping FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.ship_region
s2_ship_pct: SELECT (SELECT SUM(shipping_fee) FROM orders) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(line_total) FROM order_items)
s3_refund_by_cat: SELECT p.category, SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id AND r.line_number = oi.line_number JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.category
s3_net_of_refunds: SELECT (SELECT SUM(line_total) FROM order_items) - (SELECT SUM(refund_amount) FROM returns)
s3_refund_rev_by_cat: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.line_total) as net_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) as total_refunds FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key LEFT JOIN returns r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id AND oi.line_number = r.line_number GROUP BY p.category
s5_ship_pct_region: SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) * 100.0 / SUM(oi.line_total) as shipping_pct FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.ship_region
s7_vocab_paidsearch: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'paid search'
s7_vocab_paidsearch_orders: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'paid search'
s7_ambiguous_best: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.line_total) as total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.product_key, p.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
s8_rev_2024: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) = 2024
s8_rev_fy2024: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) = 2023 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_ts) >= 2) OR (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) = 2024 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_ts) = 1)
s8_rev_by_month: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_ts) as month, SUM(oi.line_total) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) = 2024 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_ts) ORDER BY month
s8_rev_2023: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) = 2023
